$comment: Copy to ~/.config/command-center/config.json (or $CC_CONFIG_DIR/config.json). Every key is optional; missing keys use the defaults shown here. `~` and `$HOME` are expanded. Secrets do NOT go here — see .env.example.

user.$comment: How the agents refer to you, and your Atlassian identity for skills that assign tickets.
user.name: Your Name

dirs.$comment: config = state dir (agents.jsonl, inbox.jsonl, todos.json, tui.log). projects = where project directories live. skills = roots scanned for /skill-name completion in chats.

commands.$comment: agent = command typed into a tmux pane to start an AI agent (a shell alias such as cursor-cli or claude is fine — panes run your interactive shell). projectModel = Cursor CLI model slug for each project's central agent (see `cursor-cli --list-models`; "" = CLI default; ignored for other agent CLIs). mkpanes = path to the mkpanes script. terminal = switch (one window; start-project switches the tmux client to the project's session, see tmux/command-center.tmux) | alacritty | terminal (macOS Terminal.app — a new OS window per project) | none. tmuxSession = session that receives new ticket windows; null = current/first.

jira.$comment: baseUrl for browse links and REST transitions. cloudId is what the Atlassian MCP tools need. sprintField is the custom field holding the sprint.

central.$comment: mode = tmux: the central manager is commands.agent (cursor-cli) in a pane under the TUI in the Command Center tmux window, started by cc-central; specialists report to it through cc-mail, it steers every agent with cc-instruct, and tab 1 is a read-only view of its chat. embedded: a Cursor SDK agent inside the TUI with a chat on tab 1. dir = the tmux agent's cwd / mailbox / prompt / LOG.md. model = Cursor CLI slug for it; "" = commands.projectModel.

projects.$comment: Directory names under dirs.projects that are not projects.

mail.$comment: Inter-agent messages (cc-mail). An idle agent is nudged by typing into its pane only when the human cannot be typing there (pane off screen, or its window quiet for quietSeconds) and its input box is empty; otherwise a detached retrier re-tries every retrySeconds for up to retryMinutes. Mail still waiting after staleMinutes is flagged as stuck in the TUI and to the owning specialist.

email.$comment: Inbox tab. days = how far back to read. filters = noise rules merged by name with the defaults in src/data/emailFilters.ts (which also ships disabled suggestions such as jira-comments, gitlab-mr-threads, snyk-alerts, datadog-digest, fathom-recaps). A rule hides mail when all its regexes (case-insensitive) match from / subject / body, unless `unless` matches the subject or body. Hidden mail stays in Outlook untouched; `h` on the tab shows it.

todos.$comment: Focus todos: the todos specialist pings central when a focus todo has had no progress note for focusCadenceMinutes, only inside focusHours on weekdays and never during a meeting. focusMax is a soft cap.

repos.$comment: Repo alias → path for the worktrees tab and mkpanes-style launches. Leave empty to parse the alias list from the mkpanes script instead.
